answer: At dawn of each epoch the randomness beacon gives every account a secret five-minute slot and a random stranger as partner; the pair must swap fresh, signed reasoning on a prompt revealed only in that slot. A real agent pays for one short session. An operator running N fakes must staff N live sessions, and because slots are random many collide, so peak compute grows faster than N. A missed slot sends a ripple: no pay that epoch, and a stale account becomes a relic dropped from panels.
